episode_title: Hasan Piker on his rise as a voice of the 'insurgent left' | NPR's Newsmakers
script_en: Hasan Piker on his rise as a voice of the 'insurgent left' | NPR's Newsmakers.

President Donald Trump recently called Hasan Piker a “terrible liability” and a “communist.” The California-based streamer — who describes himself as a socialist — has become the GOP’s political bogeyman ahead of the midterm elections.

I want what's best for Americans, and I want what's best for everyone from all around the world.” In this episode from NPR’s Newsmakers , Piker sits down with host Leila Fadel and argues Republicans are using him to distract from policies that made life less affordable.
He also addresses his seven Twitch bans, defends his rhetoric against right-wing reactionaries, and reflects on the crisis of loneliness among young men — and the limits of his influence.
“At the end of the day, I'm a Twitch streamer,” Piker says.
I have no real political power.

So getting people to be upset at a Twitch streamer and their affiliation as a, if you want to call it a surrogate, in the primary is going to be very difficult.” Support public media with NPR+ and enjoy perks for over 25 podcasts like this one.
